entities.name: Abd al-Wahid Ibn Ashir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd al-Wahid Ibn Ashir known as Imam Ibn Ashir or simply Ibn Ashir was a Maghrebi jurist in the Maliki school from [[Andalus,],. His Murshid al-Mu'een is arguably the best known of the Maliki texts in the Islamic world. It is still widely sung and memorised in madrasas and Quranic schools throughout North Africa to this day.
